title: Account locked after password change
description: My domain account is locked on LAB-PC-014. I changed my password yesterday and Windows now says the account is locked out. One user affected.

title: VPN authentication fails after password change
description: VPN client rejects authentication after a Windows password change. Home internet works. Alex Morgan cannot access the internal ERP from LAB-LT-042 and a delivery deadline is approaching.

title: Internal portal hostname does not resolve
description: The operations department cannot resolve portal.northstar.example. Access by the approved test IP 192.0.2.20 works. All department users are affected; a workaround exists.

title: Warehouse printer appears offline
description: LAB-PRN-003 is offline and shipping documents are stuck in the print queue. Four warehouse staff are affected. Labels are needed before the next dispatch.

title: Windows 11 workstation is slow
description: LAB-PC-025 is slow when opening applications. Windows 11 reports low disk space after an update. Only one employee is affected and another workstation is available.

title: Outlook repeatedly requests sign-in
description: Outlook on LAB-LT-018 repeatedly asks for Microsoft 365 sign-in. Outlook on the web works for Taylor Reed. No other users have reported the issue.

title: Access denied to mapped finance drive
description: Jordan Lee receives Access denied on \\files.northstar.example\finance after a team move. Other network drives work. An authorized colleague can handle urgent requests.

title: ERP unavailable across all locations
description: The fictional Northstar Demo ERP returns HTTP 503 for all locations. Order processing has stopped and there is no workaround. Started at 09:15 UTC.
